name: Dimmer Plug
description: A plug-in module that lets a dimmable lamp be turned on and off and dimmed remotely. The lamp plugs into the module, which plugs into a wall outlet.

steps.text: Turn on your lamp and plug its power cord into the bottom of the dimmer module.
Plug the dimmer module into an unswitched wall outlet.

notes: Leave the lamp's own switch on; if it is off, the module can't control the lamp.
Only connect lamps with dimmable bulbs.

steps.text: Press and hold the SET button to enter linking mode.

notes: Linking is directional: the first device put into linking mode becomes the controller and the second the responder. The module leaves linking mode once a link is made or after four minutes without one.

As a responder: on the controller, press and hold the SET button (on a multi-button controller, tap the button first) until it beeps; make sure the module is on, then press and hold its SET button until it double-beeps.
To have two devices control each other, cross-link them: link once in each direction.
When using the Hub or another central controller, let it manage links instead of linking manually.

verification.note: When adding the module to the Hub, the Dimmer Plug 2457D2 Owner's Manual says to hold the SET button until the module double-beeps; the 2016 quick start guide says until it beeps.

steps.text: Press and hold the SET button to enter linking mode.
Tap the SET button to move to multi-linking mode.
Press and hold the SET button on each responder until it double-beeps.
Tap the SET button to finish.

notes: The module stays in multi-linking mode for 4 minutes or until its SET button is tapped.

verification.note: Read from the local programming flowchart (press and hold to move right, tap to move down) and the multi-linking description; the manual has no step-by-step multi-linking procedure for the module itself.

steps.text: With the controller in unlinking mode, press and hold the SET button until the module double-beeps.

notes: Put the controller in unlinking mode first: press and hold its SET button until it beeps (on a multi-button controller, tap the button first), then press and hold it again until it beeps.
In its own unlinking mode the module leaves the mode once a link is removed or after four minutes.

steps.text: Unplug the dimmer module from its outlet.
Press and hold the SET button while plugging the module back in.
Keep holding the SET button until the module stops beeping.

steps.expect: double beep when the reset is complete

notes: Linking and unlinking modes time out after 4 minutes.
Setting the on-level to 0 turns on resume dim.
Versions before 3.6 support X10; load sense is supported from version 3.6.

The 2014 to 2016 owner's manuals print subcategory 0x37, which the DIN Rail Dimmer 2452 reports in Australia and New Zealand; Insteon Device Categories (January 2014) gives the 2457D2 only 0x01/0x0E. A later hardware revision may report 0x37.
